title: Comment Thread
content: Create threaded comment system. Comment structure: avatar (w-8 h-8), header (name, timestamp), content text, actions row. Actions: Like with count, Reply, Edit/Delete for own comments, Report. Replies: indented below parent (pl-8), connecting line. Nested replies: support 2-3 levels deep. Reply form: appears inline when Reply clicked. Like animation: heart fill with scale. Relative timestamps. Real-time: new comments appear with animation.

variants.simple: Create threaded comments with replies, likes, and reply form.
variants.detailed: Create threaded comment system. Comment structure: avatar (w-8 h-8), header (name, timestamp), content text, actions row. Actions: Like with count, Reply, Edit/Delete for own comments, Report. Replies: indented below parent (pl-8), connecting line. Nested replies: support 2-3 levels deep. Reply form: appears inline when Reply clicked. Like animation: heart fill with scale. Relative timestamps. Real-time: new comments appear with animation.
variants.advanced: Create threaded comment system with nested replies and interactions. Comment container: space-y-4 for top-level comments. Comment structure: flex gap-3 for avatar + content layout. Avatar: w-8 h-8 rounded-full, link to profile. Comment body: flex-1. Header row: flex items-center gap-2, name (font-medium text-sm hover:underline), verified badge if applicable, timestamp (text-xs text-gray-500 relative: "2h", title with full date). Content text: text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap, linkify URLs and mentions. Actions row: flex items-center gap-4 mt-1 text-xs text-gray-500. Like button: Heart icon (w-4 h-4), count, click toggles with scale animation and fill-red-500 when liked. Reply button: opens inline reply form. More dropdown: Edit (own comments, switches to edit mode), Delete (own comments, confirms then removes or shows "[deleted]"), Report (others). Replies container: ml-8 or ml-10 (indentation), optional vertical connecting line (border-l-2 border-gray-200) from parent. Nested replies: support 2-3 levels deep with increasing indent, beyond that show "View more replies" link that expands or navigates to focused view. Reply form: appears inline below comment when Reply clicked, flex gap-2 with avatar (w-6 h-6), textarea (auto-resize), submit button, Cancel to close. Like animation: heart icon fill with brief scale-125 transition. Relative timestamps: "2h", "1d", "2w", "Jan 15" for older. Load more: "Load X more replies" button for long threads, or automatic with intersection observer. Sort options: Newest first, Oldest first, Most liked (dropdown above comments). Real-time updates: new comments appear at top or inline with subtle highlight animation (bg-blue-50 fade out). Collapse/expand: long threads can be collapsed with "Hide replies" toggle. Deleted comments: soft delete showing "[deleted]" placeholder maintaining thread structure. Edited indicator: "edited" text after timestamp on modified comments. Loading: skeleton comments. Empty state: "No comments yet. Be the first!" Accessibility: nested list structure, announce new comments with aria-live.
